screen.script:
n = 0 pulse = false
function ogui_on_load() ogui.set("status", "text", "script ready at t=" .. string.format("%.2f", ogui.time())) ogui.log("layout_script: ogui_on_load") end
function ogui_on_click(key) if key == "add" then n = n + 1 elseif key == "sub" then n = n - 1 elseif key == "pulse" then pulse = not pulse ogui.set("pulse", "text", pulse and "pulse: on" or "pulse: off") end ogui.set("count", "text", "n = " .. n) ogui.set("meter", "value", math.min(1, math.max(0, (n + 5) / 10))) end
function ogui_on_update(t, dt) if pulse then ogui.set("meter", "value", 0.5 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 3)) end end
